# Suntherm Insulation

> Leading global manufacturer of ceramic fiber, rock wool, and advanced refractory insulation materials for industrial applications.

Suntherm Group operates manufacturing facilities producing high-performance insulation products including ceramic fiber, rock wool, and bio-soluble fiber materials. The company serves industrial sectors requiring thermal protection and refractory solutions across multiple continents.
